verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a documented platform, so agent-oriented docs or an llms.txt file is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions llms.txt, markdown docs for LLMs, or any agent-oriented documentation. The marketing line about APIs that 'AI systems can safely act on' describes the product's declarative APIs, not docs for agents, so it is an adjacent claim and earns no credit.
